entities.summary: Alexander Sergeivich Famintsin (1841-1896) was a Russian composer, critic, musicologist and scholar. He was one of the early faculty members of the renowned Saint Petersburg Conservatory. He was a pupil of Ignaz Moscheles, Moritz Hauptmann and Ernst Richter and friend of Alexander Serov.
